scope.quote: publishes open-source software and corresponding reproducible scholarly articles

rules.quote: References are provided in a .bib BibTeX database
rules.requirement: Provide references in a BibTeX database.

rules.quote: should contact the editors-in-chief prior to engaging in such work.
rules.requirement: For closed-source software reviews or comparisons, contact the editors-in-chief before beginning.

rules.quote: code input/output must fit within the normal textwidth
rules.requirement: Keep code input and output within the manuscript text width.

rules.quote: Descriptions of open-source software targeting less broad problems, for example compact yet sophisticated code to estimate novel models using existing software infrastructure, can be published as code snippets in JSS.
rules.requirement: Reserve code snippets for compact software contributions addressing narrower problems.

rules.quote: should not contain comments within the verbatim code.
rules.requirement: Place explanatory comments outside verbatim code blocks.

rules.quote: \documentclass[codesnippet]{jss}
rules.requirement: Use the JSS codesnippet document class for a code snippet contribution.

rules.quote: Articles describing a novel software contribution must cover implementations with a similar scope
rules.requirement: Discuss comparable implementations, including other languages or software environments.

rules.quote: The license(s) of the software is clearly indicated
rules.requirement: Clearly identify the software license.

rules.quote: must present the scope of the software and the underlying models or concepts
rules.requirement: Explain software scope and underlying models or concepts.

rules.quote: A description of the design principles and the actual implementation
rules.requirement: Describe design principles and the implementation.

rules.quote: discuss the advantages and disadvantages of the new contribution compared to existing implementations
rules.requirement: Discuss advantages and disadvantages compared with existing implementations.

rules.quote: Manuscripts must be written in English using the LaTeX text
rules.requirement: Write the manuscript in English using LaTeX.

rules.quote: All captions should appear below the corresponding figure/table.
rules.requirement: Put captions below their figures or tables.

rules.quote: The captions should be in sentence style and end with a period.
rules.requirement: Use sentence style and a final period in captions.

rules.quote: Figures, tables and equations are marked with a \label
rules.requirement: Label figures, tables and equations, and refer to them by reference.

rules.quote: All figures, tables, and other output presented in the manuscript must be fully and exactly reproducible on at least one platform.
rules.requirement: Make all figures, tables, and output exactly reproducible on at least one platform.

rules.quote: we require all submissions to be formatted using LaTeX and the JSS style files
rules.requirement: Format the manuscript with LaTeX and JSS style files.

rules.quote: this should be explained in the submission and a link should be provided.
rules.requirement: If attachments exceed upload capacity, explain this and link to the material.

rules.quote: The manuscript can be compiled by pdfLaTeX.
rules.requirement: Ensure the LaTeX manuscript compiles with pdfLaTeX.

rules.quote: includes the GPL-2 or GPL-3 or a GPL-compatible license for publication in JSS
rules.requirement: Use GPL-2, GPL-3, or a GPL-compatible software license.

rules.quote: JSS does NOT publish methodological innovations in computational statistics.
rules.requirement: Establish that the manuscript is primarily about software rather than a new statistical methodology.

rules.quote: languages requiring non-standard interpreters or compilers must include all tools necessary to run the code
rules.requirement: For nonstandard runtimes, include the tools needed to run the software.

rules.quote: must be illustrated by an enlightening non-trivial case study.
rules.requirement: Illustrate the analysis workflow with a substantive case study.

rules.quote: publishes open-source software and corresponding reproducible scholarly articles
rules.requirement: Describe open-source statistical software and a corresponding reproducible article.

rules.quote: the code needs to come with formatted help files and be packaged for easy installation.
rules.requirement: For package ecosystems, provide formatted help files and an installable package.

rules.quote: I/we have prepared a PDF manuscript in JSS style.
rules.requirement: Submit a PDF manuscript formatted in JSS style.

rules.quote: Please indicate any platform dependencies with the submission.
rules.requirement: Identify platform dependencies in the submission.

rules.quote: Novel models or estimation procedures should be published elsewhere prior to the submission
rules.requirement: Ensure novel models or estimation procedures were published separately before submitting the implementation article.

rules.quote: Make sure to initialize the generator for pseudo random numbers if the results rely on some form of simulation.
rules.requirement: Initialize the pseudorandom generator when simulation results depend on it.

rules.quote: The replication materials must enable reproducibility of all results from the manuscript
rules.requirement: Ensure the supplied materials reproduce every reported result.

rules.quote: Revisions, in any state of the review process, must always be submitted together with a point-to-point reply
rules.requirement: Include a point-by-point reply with any revision.

rules.quote: \section, \subsection, etc. in sentence style,
rules.requirement: Use sentence style for section headings.

rules.quote: Software packages are \cite{}d properly.
rules.requirement: Cite software packages appropriately.

rules.quote: Software WITHOUT a corresponding article documenting and illustrating the implementation and application of this software can not be published in JSS.
rules.requirement: Accompany submitted software with an article documenting and illustrating it.

rules.quote: Source code must be submitted in ASCII files.
rules.requirement: Submit source code as ASCII text files.

rules.quote: It should be readable and have comments.
rules.requirement: Make submitted source code readable and commented.

rules.quote: The JSS Style Guide must be followed
rules.requirement: Follow the JSS Style Guide when formatting the manuscript.

rules.quote: I/we have prepared the replication materials for all results from the manuscript
rules.requirement: Provide replication materials for every result in the manuscript.

rules.quote: I/we have prepared the source code for the software.
rules.requirement: Provide the software source code with the submission.

rules.quote: \title in title style
rules.requirement: Format the title in title style.
